articles.title: Hackers Use AI Agents to Target Over 2,250 Microsoft 365 Tenants Through ConnectWise
articles.summary:
Hackers used AI agents and stolen ConnectWise application credentials to attempt access to more than 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants, according to Microsoft’s technical investigation report. Microsoft attributed the campaign to Storm-0940, a China-state-aligned group, and said its ARTEX framework accelerated reconnaissance, authentication attempts, and cloud persistence. articles.title: OpenAI Codex Breaks USB Encryption in Minutes, Exposing Hardcoded Keys and Security Flaws
articles.summary:
OpenAI Codex helped researcher Xusheng Li uncover flaws in four USB protection products, including hardcoded encryption keys and hidden accounts that allowed files to be decrypted without the owner’s password. In one test, Codex identified the main weakness in seven minutes. The findings expose failures in how these products handle secrets, rather than a breakthrough […]

articles.title: Researcher Gains Root Access to Samsung Smart TV, Uncovers Extensive User Tracking
articles.summary:
